title: Committee of Supply resolutions on FY2026/27 Main and Development Estimates
what_it_is: A report of Committee of Supply resolutions and a motion for Parliament to agree to supply $158,962,520,000 under the Main Estimates and $49,014,559,600 under the Development Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
why_it_matters: The record does not set out the practical impact.

key_points.point: The Committee of Supply agreed to supply $158,962,520,000 to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure for the Public Services shown in the Main Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
key_points.speaker: unattributed
key_points.quote: That the sum of $158,962,520,000 shall be supplied to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure for the Public Services shown in the Main Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, contained in Paper Cmd 4 of 2026,

key_points.point: The Committee of Supply agreed to supply $49,014,559,600 to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure for the Public Services shown in the Development Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
key_points.speaker: unattributed
key_points.quote: That the sum of $49,014,559,600 shall be supplied to the Government under the Heads of Expenditure for the Public Services shown in the Development Estimates for the financial year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027, contained in Paper Cmd 4 of 2026,

key_points.point: The Second Minister for Finance reported that the Committee of Supply had come to certain resolutions.
key_points.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
key_points.quote: I report that the Committee of Supply has come to certain resolutions.

key_points.point: Ms Indranee Rajah moved that Parliament agree with the Committee on the said resolutions.
key_points.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
key_points.quote: That Parliament doth agree with the Committee on the said resolutions.

not_said: What specific public services will the Main Estimates fund?
What specific development projects will the Development Estimates fund?
When will Parliament vote on the motion?
When do the supply sums take effect?
What are the Heads of Expenditure in Paper Cmd 4 of 2026?
